verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents built-in background autonomy: Ari keeps the Model current, messages the user when something moves without being asked, and drafts board decks off the previous night's numbers. Users can set the nightly connection refresh time and connect Sheets that re-import when the file changes, and the pricing page lists 'Proactive alerts & triggers'. However, the evidence shows mostly vendor-defined background behaviour rather than user-authored automations; the 'triggers' claim is a single pricing line with no setup docs. Missing for 10: documented user-defined automation/trigger configuration (conditions, schedules, actions), depth on how alerts are set up, independent or hands-on corroboration.
